reviews.finding: Domain updates before async sync are not rolled back and late worklist reads can remain visible
reviews.adjudication: Pre-close accepted updates are known state and need not roll back. A controlled pending read confirms report/delivery changes after close; close now freezes the known report and delivery. Read-only IO accounting may settle separately without changing the closed domain consumer. No confirmed isolated loop callback/tool race.
